name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Input buffer with repeat-on-hold and a live console.

window-ticks.name: Buffer window (ticks)
window-ticks.description: How long an early click is remembered. 240 ticks per second: 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS.

repeat-held.name: Repeat while held
repeat-held.description: While you hold the click, fire it again on every new chance (landing, new orb).

console.name: Live console
console.description: Opens a console window logging every buffered, fired, expired and repeated click. Needs a restart.
